title: Taylor Swift's rumoured wedding celebrations begin with star-studded New York event
facts: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce held rumoured wedding celebrations at Madison Square Garden in New York City.
Travis Kelce plays in the NFL for the Kansas City Chiefs.
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce donated $26 million to US charities in New York, Nashville, and Kansas City.
An event permit obtained by the Associated Press indicated about 100 guests were expected for a pre-party.
Temperatures in New York City exceeded 100 degrees Fahrenheit (37 degrees Celsius) during the event.
Jack Antonoff is Taylor Swift's longtime music producer.
Rachel Antonoff attended the Madison Square Garden gathering.
Tree Paine serves as Taylor Swift's longtime publicist.
Zohran Mamdani serves as the Mayor of New York City.
Bradley Cooper arrived at Madison Square Garden for the event.
Gigi Hadid attended the celebration at Madison Square Garden.
Lena Dunham is the creator of the television series 'Girls'.
Sports broadcaster Erin Andrews attended the event at Madison Square Garden.
The event coincided with the July 4th weekend marking the 250th anniversary of the United States.
Taylor Swift began her music career in Nashville.
